title: Allow setting custom font for Sticky Notes
line: Sticky Notes settings now have a "Text font" chooser, so a note can use any installed font instead of only the system font.
explanation: The Sticky Note widget only stored and offered a font size; the note text always used the system font, and there was no setting for the family. The new fontFamily setting (empty = system font) adds a "Text font:" row under "Text font size:" in Appearance: the button opens the same Qt font dialog the Digital Clock uses (preselected on the current font and size, and picking a size there updates the size too), and a reset button next to it goes back to the default font. The note applies the family to its existing text the same way it already applies a size change.

commits.message:
applets/notes: allow choosing a custom font family

Sticky Notes only let you change the font size, so notes always used the
system font even when someone wanted a handwriting-style typeface. Add a
font chooser next to the size, applied to existing text like the size.

BUG: 477726
